reviewer: root, independent of the proof author
scope: Discriminant clearing for the original harmonic chart value under its integral biextension and trace-one hypotheses.

audit_groups.finding: The graph lattice with coordinates (u,phi-Su) is free and preserved by O_E. The adjoint gauge has no terms of degree below two, so its mixed exponential coefficient yields SA_a-A_bar_a^t S without a denominator 2.

The trace Gram adjugate gives Delta b_i^* integral. Every embedding takes O_E into the valuation ring, so Delta e_tau preserves the actual graph lattice and lifts Delta u_tau in the correct eigenspace.

The alternating pairing is adjoint for CM conjugation. Separating embeddings cancels a nonzero field scalar, with no unit assumption in the valuation ring. Contractions consequently occur only between conjugate types.

The explicit conjugated first-order operator has integral vector-field and multiplication coefficients by logarithmic derivatives of integral unit cocycles. The integral element w with w+bar(w)=1 is retained; replacing it by 1/2 would be invalid at two.

The chosen CM-type ordering eliminates within-side commutators. The contraction operator is a linear combination of the defining pluriharmonic Laplacians, so all positive-order Wick corrections vanish in the fraction field before integrality. No nonzero integral coefficient is divided by a factorial. Homogeneity gives exactly Delta^d.

The chart bound uses the already allowed discriminant factor. It does not supply the normalized global theta trace, determinant-ideal scalar comparison, spanning or archimedean norm. Actual chart construction remains an input.

projector_and_graph_checks.scope: Exact integral-basis field arithmetic, including dyadic discriminants; these algebraic tests do not assert existence of a trace-one geometric datum in every field.

negative_controls: Nonharmonic X_1 Y_1 retains contraction 1/2 on constant input.
Z[i] has trace( a+b*i )=2a, so no integral trace-one element.
The normalized trace of (1,0) in Z_2 x Z_2 is 1/2.

limits: The integral trace-one element is an actual retained hypothesis, not automatic for arbitrary CM fields.
This is a local chart theorem; normalized global theta trace and actual short families remain.
Exact finite checks supplement the human proof. No Lean build and no whole-node closure.
